scope: Official OpenAI verification applicability and UK giffgaff self-held mobile-number logistics, first activation, inactive number retention and roaming; independent of subscription procurement.

phone_verification.option: UK giffgaff self-held SIM (+44), NOT a reseller SMS SKU or Plus supplier
phone_verification.number_holding_model: number maintained under mobile operator contract, not permanent ownership

sources.fact: Ordinary ChatGPT signup/use generally needs no phone; Codex desktop may need verification; first API key needs phone. SMS or WhatsApp in specified 12 countries; UK not listed for WhatsApp. Landline, VoIP, Google Voice and premium numbers are not eligible.
sources.page_updated: Updated 7 days ago (relative, not exact effective date)

sources.fact: Physical SIM direct delivery limited to UK addresses; direct international shipment unsupported. eSIM mentioned separately but no guarantee of eligibility abroad.

First activation requires a payment; amount not established. New eSIM requires buying a plan and cannot be activated with PAYG credit only. Activation may take up to 24h. One active SIM per giffgaff account.

Six months without eligible activity deactivates the number. Outgoing call/text/MMS, mobile data, credit top-up or plan purchase counts; incoming OTP only not listed. Deactivated SIM cannot be reactivated; after 30 days number may be recycled.

Mainland China and Singapore listed for rest-of-world roaming. Calls/text/data roaming described; outgoing services/data require separate balance outside Europe; no promise OpenAI OTP arrives or SMS receipt fees.

evidence_categories.openai_official_rule: platform may request phone in specified flows; no guarantee it accepts any specific giffgaff number
evidence_categories.operator_policy: shipping, activation, retention and roaming rules; no claim of cross-platform validation
evidence_categories.inference: receiving only OTP does not satisfy published retention activity; UK not among WhatsApp OTP countries
evidence_categories.actual_test: no SIM ordered, activated or roamed; no OpenAI SMS tested; no Plus transaction or genuine invoice
